Here in Singida the rains are not reliable, so I must be careful with money. This plot is 1.52 hectares and I grow it intercropped — I mix my crops so if one fails another may give food. I cannot afford much chemical fertilizer, but I will put the kraal manure from my cattle on the field, and I will keep some local seed I saved from last harvest because it handles our dry soil better. I and my wife will do most of the work, but at weeding and harvest I will call a few neighbors and pay them a small amount.
